commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Andros Townsend (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+6' The referee Jarred Gillett awards Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) a yellow card.
90+5' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) for a tough tackle.
90+3' A lofted cross from Timo Werner (Tottenham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A yellow card for a tackle by Teden Mengi (Luton). Jarred Gillett doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
88' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) replaces Heung-Min Son.
86' 2 - 1 Goal! Brennan Johnson plays it to Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Thomas Kaminski. 2:1.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Luton comes to nothing.
85' Substitution. Richarlison (Tottenham) in, Yves Bissouma out.
83' Rob Edwards is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Alfie Doughty suffers an injury and Cauley Woodrow (Luton) comes on.
82' The game is interrupted now, Alfie Doughty (Luton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
81' A pass from Timo Werner (Tottenham) is intercepted by Thomas Kaminski and the move breaks down.
79' A superb shot by Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
74' Tahith Chong just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Fred Onyedinma (Luton) replaces him.
73' Tahith Chong (Luton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
73' Jordan Clark (Luton) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
71' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
70' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) produces a cunning chipped pass for Heung-Min Son, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
68' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Pape Matar Sarr is replaced by Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham).
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) comes onto the pitch so that James Maddison can be given a rest.
67' Tahith Chong (Luton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
66' Jordan Clark (Luton) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
65' Alfie Doughty (Luton) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

65' Jordan Clark (Luton) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Guglielmo Vicario easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Luton.
65' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Alfie Doughty (Luton) took the corner.
64' The ball goes out of play. Luton are awarded a corner kick. Jordan Clark (Luton) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
64' 73:27 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Clark (Luton) comes onto the pitch for Luke Berry.
63' The game is interrupted now, Thomas Kaminski (Luton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Luton are awarded the free kick.
57' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

56' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
54' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
51' 1 - 1 What bad luck! Issa Kabore (Luton) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 1:1.
50' A snap shot by Ross Barkley (Luton) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Guglielmo Vicario produces a good save to thwart him.
49' Direct free kick. Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempts to beat the opposition's defence with a fine lofted pass into the penalty box, but one of the defenders reacts well and averts the threat.
48' Tahith Chong (Luton) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
48' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
46' The foul by Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jarred Gillett.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Reece Burke (Luton) is replaced by Daiki Hashioka.
46' Ange Postecoglou makes a half-time substitution. Brennan Johnson comes on in place of Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Jarred Gillett has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alfie Doughty (Luton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45+2' Luke Berry (Luton) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. Luton will have a chance to score from a corner.
45+2' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) commits a rough foul. Jarred Gillett stops the game and makes a call.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' A dangerous towering header by Luke Berry (Luton) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
44' Luton force their opponents to concede a corner.

44' The ball falls for Alfie Doughty (Luton) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there! The ball goes behind for a corner. Luton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle. Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
40' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pedro Porro (Tottenham).
38' James Maddison (Tottenham) works the corner short.
38' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Corner kick. Tottenham will have an opportunity.
38' Timo Werner (Tottenham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
37' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
36' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Reece Burke (Luton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
36' Ross Barkley (Luton) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
33' The game is interrupted. Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
31' Jarred Gillett shows the yellow card to Ross Barkley (Luton) for a heavy challenge.
29' Timo Werner (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
27' A pass by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
23' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) plays a through ball but overhits it.

21' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jarred Gillett with no other option than to blow for a foul.
20' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the right post! What an opportunity that was!
18' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner which is cleared.
17' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Carlton Morris (Luton), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Luton.
16' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) was too forceful with his tackle and Jarred Gillett interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

15' Timo Werner (Tottenham) starts an individual run, not looking to pass to a teammate, and easily weaves through the defence to get deep inside the box. He shoots low, but misses the goal by a whisker! The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
12' The corner is swung in but Tottenham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' A cross from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Thomas Kaminski (Luton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

6' Timo Werner sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
5' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
5' Timo Werner (Tottenham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
3' 0 - 1 Tahith Chong (Luton) latches on to a precise pass inside the penalty box and produces a sweet strike that beats the goalkeeper as it goes into the bottom right corner, bouncing off the post.
2' Carlton Morris (Luton) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The first half has started.
Tottenham will kick-off.
Jarred Gillett will supervise the game today.
